rooms.name: Black Carriage
rooms.desc: High in the mountains, the pines and the fog still press close. The track forks here; the eastern branch broadens, old cobbles showing through its mud, once a road of some importance.
rooms.dm: If Strahd has invited the party or wants to steer them to him, his black carriage waits here (see the hidden carriage and horses). Otherwise: north-west through a set of iron gates (the western Gates of Barovia) that open as the party approaches and close behind it; south down the winding road to the bridge at Tser Falls (H); east to the Gates of Ravenloft (J).

objects.label: Strahd's black carriage
objects.desc: A big black coach stands at the fork facing east, its lamps lit and its door hanging open, waiting.
objects.dm: Here only if Strahd has invited the party or wants them at the castle. Room inside for eight; the horses then draw it down the east road to the Gates of Ravenloft (J) and cannot be turned from their course, not even by a skilled teamster.

objects.label: Black draft horse (under Strahd's control)
objects.dm: Draft horse. It waits for the party to board, then takes the carriage to J.

objects.label: Black draft horse (under Strahd's control)
objects.dm: Draft horse. It waits for the party to board, then takes the carriage to J.

objects.label: North-west: the western Gates of Barovia, which open as the party approaches and close behind it.
East: the old cobbled road to the Gates of Ravenloft (J).
South: the winding road down to the bridge at Tser Falls (H).
